actualScope: Direct real output-clean.ts leaf only, with bun:test. Existing7 bounded pure-leaf tests plus focused6 short ASCII string cases; four characterize current wrong CRLF results with printed literal expected/observed, two controls cover LF and bareCR.
Only the guarded Node/Bun runner and its owned fixture were executed. The runner uses its normal isolated environment; no custom provider/Host configuration or real user data.
staticOnly: Full leaf/existing test and ring-file source, selected background-shell manager/BashOutput/spec ranges, instruction source.
No dynamic producer, ring, disk, manager, BashOutput tool, ownership/session, model or OS behavior.
excluded: Any manager/tool/barrel/Engine import or construction; real background subprocess/PTY/Windows/native workflow; network/model/account/permission/security/custody/identity experiment.
VM/AST/eval, pressure tests, large input/cap/wraparound/cursor or chunk-split experiments, new ANSI/OSC/bidi/grapheme direction.
All old failed source groups, sort/memory/formatter/i18n/skills/frontmatter/patch/NDJSON directions; no recovery/retry/alternate validation.
Build/lint/typecheck/full suites and any additional product test run.
limitations: One independent cause, not four findings. Passing tests assert current bad behavior and do not mean a fix.
Literal LF expected strings preserve visible text; no byte-exact CRLF contract claimed.
Static raw producer chain only; raw retention/disk mirror source is counterevidence, not actual persistence validation.
